sn55.52:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn55.52:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu sāvatthiyaṃ vassaṃ vuttho kapilavatthuṃ anuppatto hoti kenaci deva karaṇīyena.
sn55.52:1.3: assosuṃ kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā aññataro kira bhikkhu sāvatthiyaṃ vassaṃ vuttho kapilavatthuṃ anuppattoti.
sn55.52:2.1: atha kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho kāpilavatthavā sakyā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etadavocuṃ
sn55.52:2.2: kacci bhante bhagavā arogo ceva balavā cāti.
sn55.52:2.3: arogo ceva āvuso bhagavā balavā cāti.
sn55.52:3.1: kacci pana bhante sārīputta moggallānā arogā ceva balavanto cāti.
sn55.52:3.2: sārīputtamoggallānāpi kho āvuso arogā ceva balavanto cāti.
sn55.52:4.1: kacci pana bhante bhikkhusaṅgho arogo ca balavā cāti.
sn55.52:4.2: bhikkhusaṅghopi kho āvuso arogo ca balavā cāti.
sn55.52:5.1: atthi pana te bhante kiñci iminā antaravassena bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitanti.
sn55.52:5.2: sammukhā metaṃ āvuso bhagavato sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
sn55.52:5.3: appakā te bhikkhave bhikkhū ye āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti
sn55.52:5.4: atha kho eteva bahutarā bhikkhū ye pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tattha parinibbāyino anāvattidhammā asmā lokāti.
sn55.52:6.1: aparaṃpi kho me āvuso bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
sn55.52:6.2: appakā te bhikkhave bhikkhū ye pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā tattha pari nibbāyino anāvattidhammā asmā lokā
sn55.52:6.3: atha kho eteva bahutarā bhikkhū ye tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karissantīti.
sn55.52:7.1: aparaṃpi kho me āvuso bhagavato sammukhā sutaṃ sammukhā paṭiggahitaṃ
sn55.52:7.2: appakā te bhikkhave bhikkhū ye tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino sakideva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karissanti
sn55.52:7.3: atha kho eteva bahutarā bhikkhū ye tiṇṇaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyanāti.
